text: DSH ComfyUI Workbench 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 ComfyUI 工作流与资产工作台。它通过侧栏面板和模型工具连接本机 ComfyUI，提供工作流浏览、运行、批量运行、编辑与重跑，并把生成图片及元数据整理到资产库。还可搜索与复制 Danbooru 标签，浏览姿势和服装参考图并按需获取。适合在 DSH 对话中调用自定义 ComfyUI 工作流、管理生成结果和组合提示词的用户；需要本机 ComfyUI 服务，不需要额外 API Key。

DSH ComfyUI Workbench connects DSH panels and model tools to local ComfyUI. Users can manage and run workflows, organize generated images, search Danbooru tags, and fetch pose or costume references. It is for people who want custom ComfyUI generation in DSH; a reachable local service is required.

DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「工作流生成」：模型可列出、检查并运行本地工作流，也可批量提交任务；生成完成后可查询运行状态。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「资产相册」：面板扫描已授权目录中的图片，支持筛选、查看元数据与缩略图，并提供删除和批量导出等资产操作。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「工作流编辑」：模型可修改工作流标题、说明、标签或单节点参数，并可选择将修改写回本地模板。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「提示词标签搜索」：标签面板可搜索 Danbooru 分类标签并复制结果；模型工具还能按中文或标签查询并同步标签资料。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「姿势与服装参考库」：用户可浏览和搜索参考素材，按需获取图片并保存到 uploads，作为工作流输入。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的功能「ComfyUI 终端面板」：面板读取 ComfyUI 子进程输出或日志文件，并提供启动服务的入口。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 执行工作流时会把提示词、参数等任务数据发送到配置的 ComfyUI 服务；默认连接本机 127.0.0.1:8188。
DSH ComfyUI Workbench 的姿势图片按需从 ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app 获取并缓存在本机；图片不随插件包分发。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · dsh-comfyui-workbench：**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

给 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 ComfyUI 工作台：**把本机的 ComfyUI 工作流交给模型调用**，并管理"哪些工作流对模型可用"。

面向用户的界面是六块：资产库、工作流管理、标签库、姿势库、衣装库、ComfyUI 终端 —— 都由 ComfyUI 原生能力支撑，不新增一套平行的状态。**不内置生图前端** —— 想手工出图直接开 ComfyUI 就行。

> 本插件是 [`dsh-comfyui-album`](https://github.com/YuChenLiao/dsh-comfyui-album) 的继任者，资产浏览能力从相册继承（源码同源）。两者同时启用会出现两套入口与两套删除按钮，建议卸载相册。`scripts/migrate-album.mjs` 只在仓库里有 —— 装了包的人要迁移得先 clone 仓库，在仓库目录里跑。
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 九个组件：装载在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，每一条都是独立的 loader entry —— 在宿主「设置 → 插件」里能看到、能单独开关。

| --- | --- | --- |
| `comfyui-workbench:core` | 服务端 | 初始化共享运行时（ComfyUI 客户端 / 进程托管 / 资产索引 / 产物目录）；承载浏览器端。**name 必须是包根**，宿主只给包根装配 `exports["./client"]` |
| `comfyui-workbench:gallery` | 面板 | 资产库：列表、筛选、缩略图、删除、批量导出工作流 ZIP |
| `comfyui-workbench:workflow` | 面板 | 工作流管理：列表、`enabled` 开关、用途备注，外加 `/run`、`/rerun`、`/config`、服务托管接口 |
| `comfyui-workbench:tags` | 面板 | 标签库：搜索四类标签、按语义大类筛、一键复制 tag；浏览只读，「更新标签」按钮会从上游刷新数据 |
| `comfyui-workbench:poses` | 面板 + 工具 | 姿势库：288 组人体姿势 / 1439 个角度，搜索与体系、分类筛选，取线稿存进 uploads 当工作流输入图；另出 `comfyui_pose_search`、`comfyui_pose_fetch` 两个工具 |
| `comfyui-workbench:costumes` | 面板 + 工具 | 衣装库：1407 套现实衣装（图中无人物），搜索与分类筛选，**每条都带英文关键词**，取图存进 uploads 当参考图；另出 `comfyui_costume_search`、`comfyui_costume_fetch` |

| `comfyui-workbench:danbooru` | 工具 | `danbooru_lookup`、`danbooru_lookup_batch`、`danbooru_sync`：角色 / 画师 / 作品 / 通用标签库（含中文名，四类共 99372 条）。不碰 ComfyUI 运行时，可单独关 |
| `comfyui-workbench:terminal`
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 九个组件：关掉某一条只影响它自己：例如关掉 `gallery`，资产库路由随之 404，工作流管理与工具照常（两个例外：批量导出工作流 ZIP 要读图与 sidecar，依赖相册；关掉 `core` 等于关掉整个插件——HTTP API 与浏览器端都会消失）。
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 安装：```sh
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 发布态：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:YuChenLiao/dsh-comfyui-workbench

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 本地开发：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/dsh/dsh-comfyui-workbench
```

装完重启 DSH。`cordis.patch.yml` 里会插入十条 entry（包根 core + 九个组件），配置用 YAML 锚点共享，只写一次：

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 本地开发：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: comfyui-workbench:core
      name: dsh-comfyui-workbench
      config: &cwf
        baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:8188
        autoStart: true
        disabledComponents: []
    - id: comfyui-workbench:gallery
      name: dsh-comfyui-workbench/gallery
      config: *cwf
    # :workflow / :tags / :poses / :costumes / :generate / :edit / :danbooru / :terminal 同理
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 配置：| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | ComfyUI 地址，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8188` |
| `outputDir` | 产物目录。**留空则落在 `<当前工作区>/comfyui-output`**；探测不到工作区时回退到 `<插件数据目录>/outputs`（`GET /config` 的 `outputSource` 会显示 `data`，`workspaceProbe` 给出探测过程：`cwd` 是否被判为宿主内部目录、`workspaceRegistry` 服务取到几个路径）。要钉死位置就显式配置这一项 |
| `workflowsDir` | 工作流仓库，默认 `~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/workflows` |
| `autoStart` | 探测到本机安装时是否自动拉起 ComfyUI。**提交任务、列工作流、看工作流详情都会触发这一步**（等到 `/system_stats` 通为止，上限 `readyTimeoutMs`），所以不用先手动启动；只停自己拉起的进程 |
| `idleShutdownMs` | 空闲多久后停止「自己拉起的」进程。**默认 `0`（不回收）**——`/queue` 只能看到 prompt 队列、看不到模型下载，回收容易在你拉大模型时把进程打断；想省显存再设成 `300000`。开着时回收前会先问 `/queue`，**有任务在跑或在排队就顺延**；外部实例永不被停 |
| `disabledComponents` | 关掉的组件，如 `['panel.gallery']`。空数组即全开 |
| `timeoutMs` | 单次 HTTP 请求超时。`/run`、`/rerun` 的 `timeoutMs` 另外用来**放宽**后台盯守时长（下限 30 分钟，传更小的值会被抬高，实际预算写在返回的 `notes` 里） |

| `progressStream` | 用 `/ws` 读精确进度（默认 `false`）。**可以在「工作流管理」面板上直接开关**，不用改这个文件 —— 这里的值只是"默认值"，面板上的开关写的是插件数据目录的 `settings.json`，改完下一次提交就生效。也可用 `COMFYUI_PROGRESS_WS=1`。开了之后面板提交的记录会带 `progress: {value, max}`；只影响 `/run`、`/rerun`，工具侧没有 |
| `roots` | 额外纳入资产库的目录（默认已含当前工作区、`dsh-comfyui-image` 的 `ou

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 模型工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `comfyui_workflow_list` | 列出**可用的**工作流：id、标题、用途备注、底模、输入种类、输出形状。被停用的不列出（`hiddenCount` 告知藏了几条）。拿不到 `/object_info` 时不标缺模型，避免把"离线"说成"缺模型" |
| `comfyui_workflow_inspect` | 不传 `nodeId` 给 IO 面与节点清单；传了给单节点完整配置。顺带报告缺节点、缺模型与可用的替代 |
| `comfyui_run` | **默认异步**：提交后立即返回 `promptId`，后台盯着并在出图后主动通知对话。支持 `wait: true` 同步等、`promptId` 续查。停用的工作流直接拒绝。**服务没在跑会自动拉起**（等到 `/system_stats` 通为止，默认上限 `readyTimeoutMs` 3 分钟），提交排在拉起之后 —— 不需要先手动启动 ComfyUI，也不该在它加载 / 下载模型时 kill 进程 |
| `comfyui_workflow_edit` | 改标题 / 说明 / 标签，以及单节点参数。默认只影响下一次运行，写回模板需 `persist` + `expectHash`。被变量绑定的参数不能在这里改（会报 `param_bound`），变量请经 `comfyui_run` 的 `vars` 传 |
| `comfyui_node_search` | 按类名 / 显示名 / 别名 / 分类 / 输入输出类型 / 包名搜索本机节点，四档排序。默认只回一行摘要，`detail` 才给输入输出 |
| `comfyui_rerun` | 用某个产物当时的参数再跑一次（或做几张变体）。参数从产物旁的 sidecar 读，不必手抄 seed / prompt |
| `comfyui_runs` | 查任务状态：正在跑（`state: running`）、排队中（带 `queuePosition`）、最近完成或失败的。进度只落记录、**不进对话**，所以不打断当前回合。`progress` 字段只在开启 `progressStream` 时出现，而且**只对面板 `/run`、`/rerun` 提交的运行有**（工具提交的没有）——缺这个字段不代表异常；开启后百分比按采样节点重置，会回跳 |
| `comfyui_run_batch` | 一次提交多个任务（同一工作流跑多组参数，或不同工作流各跑一次）。逐条报结果，**一条失败不影响其它条**；默认全部异步 |
| `danbooru_lookup` | 按中文名 / 日文名 / Danbooru
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 模型工具：工作流的"可用"由 `<id>.meta.json` 的 `enabled` 决定（缺省 `true`），面板与 `comfyui_workflow_edit` 写同一份文件。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：模型写提示词时常常知道「甘雨」却不知道 `ganyu_(genshin_impact)`，或者反过来。`danbooru_lookup` 把两边对上，**只返回 tag**：

```json
{ "ok": true, "tags": ["ganyu_(genshin_impact)"], "source": "local" }
```

上下文是稀缺资源，所以结果里不放 `postCount`、别名列表、匹配方式这些 —— 模型要的只是"这个名字对应哪个 tag"。

**主站挂了会自动换镜像**：`safebooru.donmai.us` 是 Danbooru 官方的 SFW 镜像 —— 同一套接口、同一份数据（实测 `post_count`、wiki 的 `other_names`、别名反查结果与主站逐字段一致）。主站超时（8 秒无响应）、`5xx`、`429` 或端点 `404` 时自动切过去，查询结果不变。切过一次之后会优先走能用的那个。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：不能用的是 `aibooru.online` 这类「同一套软件、不同数据库」的站：它的 `hatsune_miku` 是 1821 帖而主站是 148311，拿它当镜像会给出错误的热度与结果。

**本地没数据也能查**：库为空或没命中时会自动走 Danbooru 在线接口（`source` 变成 `online`）。中文/日文名走 `search[other_names_match]`（这是 Danbooru 唯一能按别名反查的字段），纯英文名走 `search[name_matches]` 模糊匹配 tag。所以没同步过也能立刻用，只是慢一点、且每次查询都打网络。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：**首选数据源**是 [`danbooru-tags-data-zh`](https://github.com/amenorira/danbooru-tags-data-zh)（MIT，© 2026 amenorira）——**数据随插件内聚在 `data/danbooru/`**，装好即可用，不必先联网同步：社区维护的中文翻译库，收录 Danbooru 上图片数 > 50 的标签，含中文名、别名（社区昵称也有，比如初音的「葱娘」）和一句注释（注释只入库、不进查询结果 —— 模型只需要 tag）。

**四类全导，合计 99372 条**：

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：| 类别 | 条数 | 有中文/别名 | 文件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 角色 character | 35384 | 98.7% | `characters.jsonl` |
| 画师 artist | 24881 | 94.9% | `artists.jsonl` |
| 作品 copyright | 8414 | 96.6% | `copyrights.jsonl` |
| 通用 general | 30693 | 98.9% | `general.jsonl` |

`general` 是动作、服装、外貌、构图这些非角色非画师的标签，`copyright` 是作品名（`touhou` → 东方Project）。四类一起建 2-gram 倒排索引：读取+解析 129ms、建索引 420ms、常驻约 **172 MB**、单次查询 **约 1ms**（线性扫描 56ms，快约 45 倍）。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：**通用标签带语义分类**。Danbooru 的 tag 分组（`tag_groups` 是 wiki 不是 API）抓下来是 **91 个组、15064 个 tag**，归并成八类：动作 / 服装 / 外貌 / 构图 / 物件 / 主题 / 性相关 / 其它。`danbooru_lookup` 的 `category` 参数可以「只在服装里找」：

```text
danbooru_lookup({ query: 'skirt', category: 'clothing' })   → ["skirt"]
danbooru_lookup({ query: 'sitting', category: 'action' })   → ["sitting", "seiza", ...]
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：覆盖率要心里有数：这 91 组（15064 个 tag）对 `general` 的 30693 条只直接命中 **26.9%**（8261 条），其余落「其它」——`ponytail`、`braid` 这种最常见的词都不在 wiki 分组里。所以**分类是增强维度，搜索才是主路径**；筛不到时工具会明说「是筛掉的，去掉 category 再查」。更新分类用 `npm run danbooru:groups`（92 次请求，约 2.5 分钟）。

这比自己抓 wiki 强得多 —— 那份方案对画师几乎拿不到中文名（Danbooru 的画师 wiki 不填 `other_names`），而且 400 条就要 100 秒。

想把本地库更新到上游最新，下面几条按需选一条（命令要在 `package.json` 所在目录执行 —— 仓库根，或安装目录里的 `node_modules/dsh-comfyui-workbench/`）：

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：```sh
npm run danbooru:zh                        # 四类全导，约 25 秒（首次下 9 MB CSV）
npm run danbooru:zh -- --kind general      # 只导某一类（character / artist / copyright / general）
npm run danbooru:zh -- --kind character --kind artist   # 可以给多次
npm run danbooru:zh -- --dry               # 走完整下载与解析，但写到 .dry-run 子目录，不动正式库

注意它写的是**插件数据目录**（`~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru/`），不会动仓库里的 `data/danbooru/` —— 后者是随包分发的快照。想把随包数据也更新，导入完再把它同步过去：

```sh
cp ~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru/*.jsonl data/danbooru/
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：**补充路径**：也可以直接从 Danbooru 抓（`tags.json` + 逐条 `wiki_pages.json`），数据更新更及时、能拿到 wiki 里最新的别名，但请求量大、适合只抓热门段：

```sh
npm run danbooru:sync                      # 热度 ≥ 100，每类最多 3000 条
npm run danbooru:sync -- --min 0 --max 0   # 全量（角色 tag 40 万+，按实测速率 30 小时上下）
```

`--min` 是热度门槛（走 `search[post_count]=>N`），`--max` 是每类条数上限，`0` 表示不限。全量很慢 —— 瓶颈是逐条查 wiki，实测 8 并发下约 3~4 条/秒，40 万条要 30 小时上下。`--max` 就是为这个准备的：先拉热门段（比如 `--min 300 --max 400`，两类合计约四分钟），需要时再放宽。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru 标签库：**万一本地库是空的**（旧版本安装、或只拷了 `lib/` 的装置 —— `github:` 安装按 `files` 打包、`link:` 直接指向仓库，两种都带 `data/`）：查询会自动走在线（`source: online`），功能不中断，但慢得多 —— 实测本地热查询 **约 1 毫秒**（四类各建一份 2-gram 索引；新进程首查约 530ms，要先读四类合计约 20MB JSONL 再把索引建起来），在线 **约 1 秒**（纯英文 tag，每类一次模糊匹配）/ **约 2 秒**（中文名单候选）/ **4~6 秒**（中文名多候选：先 wiki 反查、再逐条回查热度），网络差时更久。结果也更窄：本地对「圣园未花」会给 `mika_(blue_archive)` 及其泳装、体操服变体共 3 个 tag，在线只回主 tag 一个。

想手工补单条也可以，但要清楚三件事：sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru
echo '{"tag":"mika_(blue_archive)","kind":"character","postCount":16024,"names":["圣园未花"]}' \
  >> ~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru/characters.jsonl
```

格式是 JSONL，**不是**上游的 CSV（运行时只读 `<kind>s.jsonl`，CSV 放进去会被忽略）。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 或者任意目录，直接给脚本路径（与 cwd 无关）：`danbooru:zh` / `danbooru:sync` 写入时都是**整份替换**：会重写整个 `<插件数据目录>/danbooru/<kind>s.jsonl`（先写临时文件再 rename，中途失败不会留半个文件）。所以上面手工追加的那几条，跑一次导入或同步后会被覆盖掉。

**没有别名时不会留空**：这类条目（随包数据里角色 473 条、画师 1258 条）的 `names` 是空数组，但仍能按 tag 名查到 —— 查 `chainsaw_man_(character)` 返回的就是它自己，`danbooru_lookup` 返回的永远是 Danbooru 认的那个标准名。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 或者任意目录，直接给脚本路径（与 cwd 无关）：自抓路径（`danbooru:sync`）会过滤掉二创活动名、带年份的、纯英文变体；导入中文库（`danbooru:zh`）则照单全收 —— 那份数据的别名本来就经过整理，含社区昵称与旧译名。**CP 名**（`レイマリ` 这种两人合称）主要靠「是否被多个 tag 共用」判断 —— 那比猜字符可靠，也不会误伤 `初音ミク`；共用时只保留在热度最高的那条记录上。另有一层保守的字符过滤（带 `×`/`&` 之类的、字面含 `cp` 的、单独一个关系词的）。这样每个别名最多对应一条结果，不会出现"查一个名字弹出两个人、都标精确"。

同步时若遇到限流或网络错误，会退避重试；仍失败的条目会在日志里报出条数（这些条目别名缺失，重跑一次即可补上）。

本组件可以单独关掉（宿主插件页，或配置 `disabledComponents: ['tool.danbooru']`），不影响生图链路。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 隐藏 NSFW：资产库工具条上，刷新按钮右侧有个省略号 —— 悬浮展开「隐藏 NSFW」。点了之后列表里判定为 NSFW 的资产会被藏起来，按钮旁显示藏了多少张。

判定是**启发式词表**，不是分类器。扫的是文件名、正向提示词、底模名与工作流 id：

- 强信号（`nsfw` / `explicit` / `hentai` / 性器官 / 中文「完全裸露」「完整裸露」「赤裸」「全裸」等）单命中即判
- 中信号（`nude` / `breast` / `lingerie` / 「裸露」「乳房」等）要凑够**两个**才算 —— 动漫 tag 里 `breasts`+`nipples` 是泳装与解剖图的标配，单命中必然误伤

**负向提示词不参与判定**。Danbooru 系底模（AnimagineXL / Pony）的官方推荐负向模板里就写着 `nsfw`，拿它判定会让一整套工作流的图全被藏起来，而那恰恰是在排除成人内容。

过滤只在渲染层：数据仍在内存里，切回「显示」立刻可见，不用重新拉。隐藏状态下的「全选」只会选看得见的那些 —— 否则一次删除会把看不见的一起删掉。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 标签库面板：第三个页签：搜 Danbooru 的四类标签（99372 条），拿到 `tag` 与中文名再贴进提示词。一个输入框同时匹配 tag、中文名、别名——查「长发」「long_hair」「长髪」都会落到 `long_hair`。

- **大类筛选带实到条数**：动作 / 服装 / 外貌 / 构图 / 物件 / 主题 / 性相关 / 其它，每个按钮旁边标着能筛出多少条。分类只覆盖通用标签的 **26.9%**（`ponytail`、`braid` 这种最常见的词都不在 Danbooru 的 wiki 分组里），所以查不到时先看计数——那是"分类没覆盖"，去掉大类再搜就有了。
- **只读 + 复制**：点「复制」拿到裸 tag，没有草稿状态。想攒提示词用 `{{变量}}` 那套工作流模板。
- 首屏约 550ms（读 129ms + 建索引 420ms，四类 99372 条），之后查询 **1–3ms**。关掉组件：`disabledComponents: ["panel.tags"]`。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 姿势库：第四块：**288 组人体姿势、1439 个角度**的人体线稿，用来给工作流找一个"人要怎么站/坐/躺"的参考图。素材出自 **ギア**（[@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)）的 [AI Pose Gallery](https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/)；中文译名、分类体系与四体系划分来自 **Anhao** 的 [中文版镜像](https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh)。本插件只做聚合，没有重画任何一张线稿 —— 详见[致谢](#数据来源与致谢)。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 姿势库：- **图不随包**。仓库里只有名称、分类与图地址（`data/poses/catalog.json`，253 KB）；线稿在用到时经**服务端代理**读取并落盘缓存到 `<插件数据目录>/cache/poses/`。浏览器不直连第三方图床 —— 既不为一张缩略图把出口 IP 交出去，也绕不开我们自己的缓存与失败短路。版权与使用限制见 [data/poses/NOTICE.md](data/poses/NOTICE.md)：素材**不得用于商业用途**，本项目的 MIT 不覆盖任何一张线稿。
- **取一次就算数**：内存 32 张 + 磁盘缓存（上限 256 MB，按最久未用清理），同一个视角的并发请求只打一次上游。上游连着失败几次会短路 30 秒，面板显示「线稿暂时取不到」而不是让几十个缩略图各自挂 20 秒超时。
- **五个角度**：正面 / 斜侧 / 侧面 / 俯视 / 仰视，卡片上直接切。287 组有满 5 个角度，1 组只有 4 个。
- **默认全给**：288 组都在，不做内容筛选。标了成人向的 190 组（性感系 + 双人体系，加两个明确分类）只在卡片上有个小标记；想收窄就勾「只看常规」，那是使用者自己的选择。
- **拿它出图**：点「取原图」把线稿存进 uploads，返回的路径就是工作流的图片输入；模型侧用 `comfyui_pose_search` 找、`comfyui_pose_fetch` 取。这个面板不自己调生图 API —— 出图只有 `comfyui_run` 一条路。
- 检索是本地线性扫 288 组（微秒级）。**这里不做倒排索引**：标签库 99372 条才值得建 2-gram，288 条建索引是负优化。
- 关掉组件：`disabledComponents: ["panel.poses"]`。数据更新：`npm run poses:import`。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 衣装库：第五块：**1407 套现实风格衣装**（图里没有人物），用来给工作流找服装参考。衣装集 **COSTUME-DB-01** 出自 **ギア**（[@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)）的 [AI Costume Gallery](https://ai-costume-gallery.pages.dev)；中文名称、中文标签与英文关键词来自 **Anhao** 的镜像。接入方式与姿势库完全一样 —— 元数据随包、图经服务端代理按需取。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 衣装库：- **自带英文关键词**，这是它比姿势库更有用的地方：每套都有一条 `ivory frill knit denim mini skirt coat socks white sneakers` 这样的英文串，卡片上一行、一键复制，直接能拼进提示词。1407 套覆盖率 100%。
- **图不随包**：`data/costumes/catalog.json`（560 KB）只有编号、中文描述、中文标签、英文关键词与图地址。图在 `ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app` 的 `thumbs/costume/` 与 `img/costume/`，格式是 **webp**（姿势库是 jpg/png，所以两条路径白名单是分开的，互不接受对方的形状）。
- **八类**：春季 215 / 夏季 254 / 秋季 244 / 冬季 253 / 内衣・睡衣 199 / 性感穿搭 140 / 泳装・度假 54 / 派对・礼服 48。
- **默认全给 1407 套**，不做内容筛选；标了成人向的 393 套（内衣、泳装、性感三类）只在卡片上有个小标记，勾「只看常规」才收窄到 1014 套。
- **缓存与短路**与姿势库共用同一个实现（`createImageCache`），只是换了缓存目录 `cache/costumes/` 与路径白名单 —— 单飞、失败冷却、字节头校验复制一遍必然漂移。
- 授权与姿势库不同：上游允许把服装图**用作创作参考**（含编辑与商业作品中的参考），但禁止再分发图像数据本身。详见 [data/costumes/NOTICE.md](data/costumes/NOTICE.md)。
- 关掉组件：`disabledComponents: ["panel.costumes"]`。数据更新：`npm run costumes:import`。
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 终端面板：第六个面板（在资产库、工作流管理、标签库、姿势库、衣装库之后），展示 ComfyUI 的**命令行输出**。想看服务在干什么、卡在哪一步、模型加载到几成 —— 这些只在终端里，GUI 上看不到。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 终端面板：- **外部启动的实例也能看**：插件拉起的进程直接接 stdout / stderr；外部实例（Desktop 自己起的那些）拿不到 stdout，改读它写的 `user/comfyui.log`。两条路只走一条 —— ComfyUI 的 logger 同时挂 Stream 与 File 两个 handler，两边都读是每行两份。
- 服务没在跑时，面板上有「启动」按钮，直接拉起，不用先回对话生成一张图。
- 1 秒轮询拉增量（带 cursor，不重复下载整屏）；自动跟随底部，但你往上翻时不会被拽回来。
- 支持暂停、按关键字过滤、清屏。缓冲保留最近 2000 行，更早的会滚出并提示。
- ANSI 转义（颜色、进度条的 `\r` 刷新）在入库前剥掉，否则是一屏乱码。
- 子进程被强制 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` —— Windows 上不指定的话 Python 按控制台代码页输出，中文全是豆腐块。

关掉它只影响这个面板（`panel.terminal`），其它组件照常。

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · 产物与通知：- 产物默认写入 `<当前工作区>/comfyui-output`，主产物旁写一份 `<文件>.json` sidecar（提示词、seed、工作流、原始尺寸、promptId）；一次出多张时只有第一张带 sidecar。

npm run build      # src → lib/index.js（宿主）+ lib/client.js（浏览器）+ lib/entries/*.js + lib/{workflow,store,run,comfy}.js（测试用）

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · dsh-comfyui-workbench：[中文](README.md) · **English**

A ComfyUI workbench for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): **hand your local ComfyUI workflows to the model**, and manage which workflows the model is allowed to use.

There are six user-facing panels — Assets, Workflows, Tags, Poses, Costumes, and the ComfyUI terminal — all backed by ComfyUI's own capabilities rather than a parallel state layer. **No built-in generation UI**: if you want to generate by hand, just open ComfyUI.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · dsh-comfyui-workbench：> This plugin is the successor to [`dsh-comfyui-album`](https://github.com/YuChenLiao/dsh-comfyui-album); asset browsing is inherited from it (shared code lineage). Running both gives you two entry points and two delete buttons — we recommend uninstalling the album plugin. `scripts/migrate-album.mjs` ships only in the repository: if you installed from a package you'll need to clone the repo and run it there.
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Nine components：Each is mounted in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` as its own loader entry — visible in the host's Settings → Plugins, and individually toggleable.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Nine components：| entry | kind | responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comfyui-workbench:core` | server | Initializes the shared runtime (ComfyUI client / process supervision / asset index / output dir) and hosts the browser bundle. **Its `name` must be the package root** — the host only assembles `exports["./client"]` for root specifiers |
| `comfyui-workbench:gallery` | panel | Assets: listing, filtering, thumbnails, deletion, bulk workflow ZIP export |
| `comfyui-workbench:workflow` | panel | Workflow admin: listing, the `enabled` toggle, purpose notes, plus `/run`, `/rerun`, `/config` and the service-supervision endpoints |
| `comfyui-workbench:tags` | panel | Tag library: search four tag categories, filter by semantic category, copy a tag. Browsing is read-only; the "update tags" button refreshes the data from upstream |
| `comfyui-workbench:poses` | panel + tools | Pose library: 288 poses / 1,439 angles of human reference sketches — search, filter by system and category, save a sketch into uploads as a workflow image input; also registers the `comfyui_pose_search` and `comfyui_pose_fetch` tools |

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Nine components：Disabling one affects only that one. Turn off `gallery`, for example and its routes 404 while workflow admin and the tools keep working. Two exceptions: bulk workflow ZIP export needs images and sidecars, so it depends on the gallery; and disabling `core` disables the whole plugin — the HTTP API and browser bundle both disappear.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Configuration：| field | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | ComfyUI address, default `http://127.0.0.1:8188` |
| `outputDir` | Where artifacts land. **Leave it empty and they go to `<current workspace>/comfyui-output`**; if no workspace can be resolved it falls back to `<plugin data dir>/outputs` (`GET /config` reports `outputSource: data` in that case, and `workspaceProbe` shows how detection went: whether `cwd` was rejected as a host-internal directory and how many paths `workspaceRegistry` returned). Pin it explicitly if you want a fixed location |

| `autoStart` | Whether to launch ComfyUI when a local installation is detected. **Submitting a run, listing workflows and inspecting a workflow all trigger it** (waits until `/system_stats` responds, capped by `readyTimeoutMs`), so there is no need to start it by hand. Only processes we started are ever stopped |
| `idleShutdownMs` | How long an **idle** instance we started is kept. **Defaults to `0` (never reclaimed)** — `/queue` only shows the prompt queue, not model downloads, so reclaiming tends to interrupt you

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Model tools：| tool | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `comfyui_workflow_list` | Lists **available** workflows: id, title, purpose note, base model, input kinds, output shape. Disabled ones are omitted (`hiddenCount` says how many). When `/object_info` is unreachable, it does not flag missing models — that would report "offline" as "missing models" |
| `comfyui_workflow_inspect` | Without `nodeId`: the IO surface plus node list. With it: one node's full config. Also reports missing nodes, missing models and available substitutes |
| `comfyui_run` | **Asynchronous by default**: returns a `promptId` immediately, watches in the background and pushes the result into the conversation when the image is done. Supports `wait: true` for synchronous waiting and `promptId` for re-checking. Disabled workflows are rejected outright. **Starts ComfyUI automatically** when it is not running (waits until `/system_stats` responds, capped by `readyTimeoutMs`, 3 minutes by default) and submissions queue behind that startup — no need to start ComfyUI by hand, and do not kill it while it is loading or downloading models |

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Model tools：A workflow's "available" flag lives in `<id>.meta.json` under `enabled` (default `true`); the panel and `comfyui_workflow_edit` write the same file.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：When writing prompts, the model often knows the Chinese name for a character but not `ganyu_(genshin_impact)`, or the reverse. `danbooru_lookup` maps between them and **returns tags only**:

```json
{ "ok": true, "tags": ["ganyu_(genshin_impact)"], "source": "local" }
```

Context is scarce, so the result carries no `postCount`, alias list or match kind — the model only needs to know which tag a name maps to.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**Failover to a mirror**: `safebooru.donmai.us` is Danbooru's official SFW mirror — same API, same data (we verified `post_count`, wiki `other_names` and alias reverse-lookups field by field against the main site). On timeout (8 s without a response), `5xx`, `429` or endpoint `404`, the plugin switches over and the result is unchanged. Once a mirror has worked, it is preferred over the main site.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：Sites running "the same software, a different database" cannot serve as mirrors. `aibooru.online` reports `hatsune_miku` at 1,821 posts versus 148,311 on the main site — using it would hand back wrong popularity and wrong results.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**Empty local library still works**: if the library is empty or has no match, the lookup goes online (`source` becomes `online`). Chinese and Japanese names go through `search[other_names_match]` (the only field Danbooru exposes for reverse alias lookup); plain ASCII names use `search[name_matches]` with fuzzy matching. So you can use it without ever syncing — just slower, with a network round-trip per query.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**The primary data source** is [`danbooru-tags-data-zh`](https://github.com/amenorira/danbooru-tags-data-zh) (MIT, © 2026 amenorira), and **the data ships inside the plugin** under `data/danbooru/`, so it works out of the box without a sync: a community-maintained Chinese translation library covering Danbooru tags with more than 50 posts, including Chinese names, aliases (community nicknames too — Miku's "葱娘" among them) and a one-line note (notes are stored but never returned; the model only needs the tag).

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**Four categories, 99,372 tags in total**:

| Category | Rows | With Chinese name / alias |
|---|---|---|
| character | 35,384 | 98.7% |
| artist | 24,881 | 94.9% |
| copyright | 8,414 | 96.6% |
| general | 30,693 | 98.9% |

`general` covers poses, clothing, appearance and composition; `copyright` is work titles (`touhou` → 东方Project). All four share one 2-gram inverted index: 129 ms to read and parse, 420 ms to build, ~172 MB resident, **~1 ms per query** (56 ms linear, roughly 45× faster).

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**General tags carry semantic categories.** Danbooru's tag groups live in a wiki page (`tag_groups` is not an API resource), scraped into **91 groups / 15,064 tags** and folded into eight buckets: action / clothing / appearance / composition / object / theme / explicit / other. The `category` parameter on `danbooru_lookup` narrows a search:

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：```text
danbooru_lookup({ query: 'skirt', category: 'clothing' })   → ["skirt"]
danbooru_lookup({ query: 'sitting', category: 'action' })   → ["sitting", "seiza", ...]
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：Coverage is limited: those 91 groups hit only **26.9%** of the 30,693 `general` tags directly (8,261), the rest land in "other" — even `ponytail` and `braid` are missing from the wiki groups. So **categories are an enhancement, search is the main path**; when a filter comes up empty the tool says it was filtered out rather than pretending nothing exists. Refresh with `npm run danbooru:groups` (92 requests, ~2.5 min).

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：To bring the local library up to date, pick one of these (run them in the directory holding `package.json` — the repo root, or `node_modules/dsh-comfyui-workbench/` in an install):

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：```sh
npm run danbooru:zh                        # fetch upstream into the plugin data dir (~5 s depending on network; the first run downloads a few MB of CSV, so call it 10 s), replacing the local copy
npm run danbooru:zh -- --kind character    # characters only
npm run danbooru:zh -- --dry               # just report how many rows would be imported
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：Note that it writes to the **plugin data directory** (`~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru/`), never to `data/danbooru/` in the repo — that copy is the snapshot shipped with the package. To update the bundled data as well, import first and then copy it over:

```sh
cp ~/.dsh-comfyui-workbench/danbooru/*.jsonl data/danbooru/
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**Supplementary path**: you can also scrape Danbooru directly (`tags.json` plus per-tag `wiki_pages.json`). Data is fresher and you get the newest wiki aliases, but the request volume is large — good for a hot slice only:

```sh
npm run danbooru:sync                      # post count >= 100, at most 3000 per kind
npm run danbooru:sync -- --min 0 --max 0   # everything (400k+ character tags, around 30 hours at measured speed)
```

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：`--min` is the popularity threshold (`search[post_count]=>N`) and `--max` caps rows per kind; `0` means unlimited. A full sync is slow — the bottleneck is per-tag wiki lookups, measured at roughly 3–4 tags/second with 8 concurrent requests, so 400k tags take about 30 hours. That is what `--max` is for: pull a hot slice first (e.g. `--min 300 --max 400`, about four minutes for both kinds) and widen later.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Danbooru tag library：**If the local library is empty** (an older install, or a setup where only `lib/` was copied — `github:` installs pack by `files`, `link:` points at the repo and both carry `data/`), lookups fall through to online (`source: online`). Function is unaffected, but it is far slower — **about 1 ms** for a warm local query (one 2-gram index per category; the first query in a fresh process takes ~530 ms, because it parses ~20 MB of JSONL across the four categories and builds the indexes), versus **about 1 s** online for a plain ASCII tag (one fuzzy match per category), **about 2 s** for a single-candidate Chinese name, and **4–6 s** when a Chinese name has several candidates (wiki reverse lookup, then a `post_count` re-query per candidate); worse on a bad network. Results are also narrower: locally, "圣园未花" yields `mika_(blue_archive)` plus its swimsuit and track variants — three tags; online returns only the main tag.

text: dsh-comfyui-workbench README · or from any directory, by script path (cwd-independent)：The scrape path (`danbooru:sync`) filters out derivative-event names, year suffixes and plain-ASCII variants; the Chinese library import (`danbooru:zh`) takes everything, since that data is already curated and includes community nicknames and older translations. **Ship names** (one name covering two characters, like `レイマリ`) are detected mainly by whether an alias is shared across multiple tags — more reliable than guessing from the text and this does not misfire on `初音ミク`; when shared, the alias stays only on the hottest record. There is also a conservative character filter (values containing `×` or `&`, literally containing `cp`, or a lone relationship word). The result is that each alias maps to at most one candidate — no more "one name returns two people, both flagged exact".

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Hiding NSFW：The asset toolbar has an ellipsis to the right of the refresh button — hover it to reveal "Hide NSFW". Once enabled, assets judged NSFW disappear from the list and the button shows how many were hidden.

The judgment is a **heuristic word list**, not a classifier. It scans the file name, the positive prompt, the base model name and the workflow id:

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Hiding NSFW：- Strong signals (`nsfw`, `explicit`, `hentai`, genital terms, and Chinese phrases like `完全裸露` / `完整裸露` / `赤裸` / `全裸`) match on a single hit
- Medium signals (`nude`, `breast`, `lingerie`, plus `裸露` and `乳房`) need **two** to trigger — in anime tags `breasts` + `nipples` are standard for swimsuit and anatomy references, so a single hit would always misfire

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Hiding NSFW：**Negative prompts are not considered.** The officially recommended negatives for Danbooru-family checkpoints (AnimagineXL, Pony) literally contain `nsfw` — judging on that would hide every image from a whole workflow setup, even when the user is in fact excluding adult content.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Hiding NSFW：Filtering happens at render time only: the data stays in memory, so toggling back is instant with no refetch. With the filter on, "select all" selects only what you can see — otherwise one delete would take the hidden items with it.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Tag library panel：The third tab: search the four Danbooru tag categories (99,372 tags), grab a `tag` plus its Chinese name, paste it into a prompt. One input matches tag, Chinese name and alias at once — `长发`, `long_hair` and `长髪` all land on `long_hair`.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Tag library panel：- **Category chips show their real counts**: action / clothing / appearance / composition / object / theme / explicit / other, each chip labelled with how many tags it can filter to. Categories cover only **26.9%** of general tags (`ponytail` and `braid`, among the most common words, are not in Danbooru's wiki groups), so when a search comes up empty check the count first — that means "not covered by a category", and dropping the chip brings the tag back.
- **Read-only browsing, with copy**: the copy button yields the bare tag, with no draft state. To build prompts up over time, use the `{{variable}}` workflow templates.
- First paint takes about 550 ms (129 ms to read + 420 ms to build the index for all 99,372 tags); queries after that take **1–3 ms**. Disable it with `disabledComponents: ["panel.tags"]`.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Pose library：The fourth panel: **288 poses / 1,439 angles** of human reference sketches, for when a workflow needs a "how does the body stand / sit / lie" reference. The sketches come from **ギア**'s ([@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)) [AI Pose Gallery](https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/); the Chinese names, action categories and the four-system split come from **Anhao**'s [Chinese mirror](https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh). This plugin only aggregates — not a single sketch is redrawn here. See [data sources and credits](#data-sources-and-credits).

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Pose library：- **Images do not ship with the plugin.** The repo only carries names, categories and image addresses (`data/poses/catalog.json`, 253 KB). Sketches are fetched on demand through a **server-side proxy** and cached to `<plugin data dir>/cache/poses/`. The browser never talks to the third-party image host — that would hand out the user's egress IP for a thumbnail and also bypass our cache and failure short-circuit. Licensing is in [data/poses/NOTICE.md](data/poses/NOTICE.md): the source material **may not be used commercially**, and this project's MIT license covers none of the sketches.
- **Fetch once, then it is local**: 32 entries in memory plus a disk cache (256 MB cap, evicting least-recently-used), with concurrent requests for the same view collapsed into one upstream call. A few consecutive upstream failures short-circuit for 30 seconds, so the panel says "sketch unavailable" instead of letting forty thumbnails each sit through a 20 s timeout.
- **Five angles**: front, three-quarter, side, high, low — switchable right on the card. 287 poses have all five; one has four.
- **Everything is available by default**: all 288 poses show up, n

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Costume library：The fifth panel: **1,407 real-world outfits** (no people in frame), for finding costume references. The outfit set **COSTUME-DB-01** comes from **ギア**'s ([@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)) [AI Costume Gallery](https://ai-costume-gallery.pages.dev); the Chinese names, Chinese tags and English keywords come from **Anhao**'s mirror. The integration is identical to the pose library — metadata ships with the plugin, images are pulled through the server proxy on demand.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Costume library：- **Every entry carries English keywords** — that is what makes this dataset more directly useful than the pose one. Each outfit has a string like `ivory frill knit denim mini skirt coat socks white sneakers`, shown on the card and copyable in one click, ready to paste into a prompt. Coverage across all 1,407 is 100%.
- **Images do not ship**: `data/costumes/catalog.json` (560 KB) holds only codes, Chinese descriptions, Chinese tags, English keywords and image addresses. Images live under `thumbs/costume/` and `img/costume/` on `ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app` in **webp** (the pose library uses jpg/png), so the two path allow-lists are separate and do not accept each other's shapes.
- **Eight categories**: spring 215 / summer 254 / autumn 244 / winter 253 / lingerie & sleepwear 199 / sexy 140 / swimwear 54 / party 48.
- **All 1,407 are listed by default** — no content filtering. The 393 flagged adult (lingerie, swimwear, sexy) only carry a small badge; tick "Safe only" to narrow down to 1,014.
- **Caching and short-circuiting** share one implementation with the pose library (`createImageCache`), differing only in cache directory (`cache/cos

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Terminal panel：The sixth panel (after Assets, Workflows, Tags, Poses and Costumes) shows ComfyUI's **command-line output**. What the service is doing, where it is stuck, how far a model has loaded — that only exists in the terminal, not in the GUI.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Terminal panel：- **Externally started instances work too**: a process the plugin launched has its stdout/stderr piped in; an external instance (one Desktop started itself) has no accessible stdout, so the panel reads the `user/comfyui.log` it writes. Only one path is active at a time — ComfyUI's logger attaches both a Stream handler and a File handler, so reading both would duplicate every line.
- When the service isn't running the panel offers a Start button, launching it directly instead of making you go generate an image first.
- Polls for increments once a second (with a cursor, so the full screen is not re-downloaded); auto-follows the tail but never yanks you back if you scroll up.
- Pause, keyword filter and clear are available. The buffer keeps the last 2,000 lines and tells you when earlier output rolled off.
- ANSI escapes (color, progress-bar `\r` redraws) are stripped before storage — otherwise the panel is a wall of garbage.
- The child process is forced to `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`; without it Python on Windows encodes its output with the console code page and Chinese text turns into tofu.
dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Terminal panel：Disabling it affects only this panel (`panel.terminal`); everything else keeps working.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Artifacts and notifications：- Artifacts go to `<current workspace>/comfyui-output` by default, with a `<file>.json` sidecar next to the main artifact (prompt, seed, workflow, original dimensions, promptId). When one run yields several images, only the first carries a sidecar.
- Images are returned as **paths plus original pixel dimensions**, never inline bytes: the host rebuilds requests per `{type:'image', attachment}` block and a raw base64 block throws and poisons every later request in that session.
- When a run finishes, the plugin pushes the result into the conversation (`Agent.followup`, source `plugin:dsh-comfyui-workbench`); the success, failure and timeout paths each deliver exactly once.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Layout：```
src/client/styles.css              shell styles (each panel keeps its own .css next to the component)
src/components/panel-gallery/      assets: server/(routes/scan/index/thumbs) + client/
src/components/panel-workflow/     workflow admin: server/(routes/run/import/config) + client/
src/components/panel-tags/         tag library: server/(index/search/sync job) + client/

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Layout：The first step of `npm test` (`node tests/arch.mjs`) enforces three boundaries: `shared` is one-directional internally (host at the bottom), a component's `server` never imports its `client` and shell modules never import a specific component. `tests/arch-write-routes.mjs` right after it walks the router's three tables and demands a `boot()` + real-fetch case for every write endpoint — unit tests that call a component handler directly have repeatedly passed while the real assembly returned 405. Coverage is currently **9/14**; the remaining five (`/delete`, `/delete-many`, `/assets/rebuild`, `/service/stop`, `/free`) sit in the script's `KNOWN_UNTESTED` allow-list, which is only meant to shrink.

npm install
npm run build      # src → lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser) + lib/entries/*.js + lib/{workflow,store,run,comfy}.js (for tests)

`node scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs` runs each workflow for real (parameters squeezed to 512 on the long edge, 1 step) to verify only that it submits, generates and retrieves.

dsh-comfyui-workbench README · Development：Importing a workflow: use the import button at the top right of the panel and paste the JSON you exported from ComfyUI with Export (API) — or pick the file directly. For batches, `node scripts/import.mjs <workflow.json>` (`--list` shows what's there). API format only — for UI-format files, use Export (API) inside ComfyUI.
